handoff.summary: two increments: commit-protocol to canon (#7) + contract verify --record, the first real ledger producer (#6f-1)
handoff.done:
**Backlog #6f-1 — contract verify --record** (commit 927905d, pushed + CI-verified green run 27575828642 conclusion=success). The FIRST automatic run-ledger producer: `socom contract verify <promise> --record` appends one row to .socom/ledger/runs.jsonl (schemas/ledger.xml 9-key wire contract) on a fully-mechanical verify, so `socom cycle`/`lesson` begin measuring REAL pass@1/pass@k instead of synthetic fixtures — the long-open ledger auto-append gap is now half-closed (verify feed done; gate/builder feeds are follow-ups). Two pure helpers (_next_attempt, _ledger_row) + IO/flag wiring; unit 51->60, +6 smoke checks. Fail-closed (§separation-of-privilege): a standalone contract (no executing seat), any manual-pending check, AND a zero-auto-check verify all WITHHOLD the row — the mechanical runner never records a verdict it cannot claim. Opt-in by design (verify is the runner; auto-recording every run would flood the ledger + inflate attempt counts). Independent reviewer ACCEPT-WITH-NITS, 8/8 contract checks; one real verify-never-claim nit (zero-check promise recorded a vacuous "kept") caught + closed + smoke-covered before commit.
**Backlog #7 — commit-protocol to canon** (commit 11ad743, pushed + CI-verified green run 27574744393 conclusion=success). Seventh Akili to SOCOM extraction. The commit format `type(scope): desc` + six blocks `[what][why][how][test][broke][next]` was already ENFORCED (commit-msg gate: subject RED, [what]/[test] amber) and named in constitution §structured-commits, but the per-block MEANING lived nowhere. Shipped `commit-protocol.xml` (byte-identical twins canon/ + .socom/canon/, added to CANON_FILES) documenting each block's distinct semantics + Akili's discipline (journey / verbatim-errors / dead-ends / one-logical-change / verification-non-negotiable / grep-the-journey) as the teaching layer. render_body emits a `## Commit protocol` section mirroring the #5 residuality block; compiled into CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/.cursor + L1-indexed (13 chunks).
**Port the pattern, not the block names**: SOCOM keeps its six blocks (the gate + constitution depend on them) — this DOCUMENTS their meaning, does not restructure them. Gate left ADVISORY on the four soft blocks (velocity-first, §psychological-acceptability).
**Design fork decided** (plan + residuality gate): Option A (canon file, mirrors residuality.xml) chosen over Option B (.gitmessage + git config commit.template). B touches machine-local git config — not git-source-of-truth, won't propagate to clones — and the gap was documentation, which A fully closes. B leashed as #7b.
Independent reviewer (clean context) verdict ACCEPT-WITH-NITS, 8/8 contract checks re-run after final edit. One cosmetic nit fixed (rendered table cell repeated its own `[id] —` label; stripped in render_body, recompiled). Evidence: diff twins empty; both parse; in CANON_FILES; section in CLAUDE.md; doctor clean (source=022e67cc361f); index 13 "artifact":"commit-protocol" chunks; xmlcheck 27 well-formed; smoke green; unit 51 passed; full-ok; pre-commit + pre-push gates PASS; CI green.
handoff.undone:

Build only if the operator wants the scaffold; the canon docs already close the meaning gap.
#6f-2 (verify->ledger DONE this session in 927905d; REST open): standalone `.socom/contracts/` storage + lifecycle, §R10 renegotiation, per-contract pass@1/pass@k in cmd_cycle, and wire `--record` into the task-completion gate / closeout so the ledger fills WITHOUT the manual flag (the next step that makes cycle measure real data by default, not just on demand). SM-3 remainder (cmd_gate CC39 / render_body CC23) — far below the eliminated cmd_cycle outlier; decompose only if they bite. precond wired into bootstrap guidance (velocity, not a blocking gate).
